# Pro Teeth Guard

> Custom night guards for teeth grinding and bruxism, designed and manufactured by a San Diego dental lab with home impression kits and online ordering.

Pro Teeth Guard specializes in custom-fitted night guards for bruxism and teeth grinding, offering multiple guard types (soft, hard, hybrid, ultra-thin) with a money-back guarantee. The company provides at-home impression kits, detailed care instructions, and customer support across the USA and Canada.
